queries.name: AnyLog workshop / Latest readings
queries.sql:
SELECT timestamp, sensor, value
FROM readings
WHERE sensor = @sensor -- one sensor per run
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 20

queries.name: AnyLog workshop / Last hour count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS readings FROM readings WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - 1 hour

props.text: Create the AnyLog query node connection, test it, then open Named queries. Run Latest readings with a sensor name from your node and Last hour count. Try the Affected rows result type: it stays unavailable because this connection is read-only.
